price_series_reason: One OHLC series is required. Bid is used for highs, lows, closes, swings, lines, and levels. Ask is not mixed in, and the series was not chosen by comparing outcomes.
neighbours: The two candles before and the two candles after the pivot must each be exactly one timeframe period later than the previous candle. A larger step rejects the window.
ties: A high that equals the highest neighbour is a tied candidate, not a swing. A low that equals the lowest neighbour is a tied candidate, not a swing.
confirmation_time: available_at of the second subsequent completed candle
availability_time: Identical to confirmation_time. R.40 defined one earliest-use time.
equal_swing_prices: Equal confirmed prices produce relation UNCERTAIN. They are neither higher nor lower.
stale_policy: No time expiry. R.40 did not define staleness. A gap blocks a window that needs the missing candle and does not erase swings already confirmed.
trend_state: UPTREND requires the latest confirmed high to be HIGHER_HIGH and the latest confirmed low to be HIGHER_LOW. DOWNTREND requires LOWER_HIGH and LOWER_LOW. Any other pair of definite relations is TRANSITION. A missing or UNCERTAIN relation is UNCERTAIN.
state_changes: A state is stored at each completed candle. It can change only when a swing available at that candle changes the latest relation.
line_pairing: Each newly confirmed swing forms one line with the immediately previous confirmed swing of the same type. Older swings are not searched.
slope: price change divided by elapsed UTC seconds between pivot open timestamps, including weekends
line_sample: The line is evaluated at the candle available_at, which is the close time.
exact_abs_tol_meaning: Numerical equality for TOUCH_EXACT and close-on-line. It is not a pip, spread, or proximity band.
touch_reach: Support: low is at or through the line and close is strictly back above it. Resistance: high is at or through the line and close is strictly back below it. A near miss that does not reach the line is not a touch.
break: Support: close is strictly below the line. Resistance: close is strictly above the line. The first candle of a beyond run is BREAK. Later candles that remain beyond are BEYOND_CONTINUATION, not new breaks. A wick through the line with the close back on the original side is a touch, not a break.
close_on_line: A close within numerical equality of the line is CLOSE_ON_LINE. It is not a break and not a reach.
event_timing: A candle can interact with a line only when the candle available_at is strictly after the line available_at.
levels: A confirmed swing low is support and a confirmed swing high is resistance, from the swing confirmation time. R.40 did not define level retirement, so invalidation_time stays null.
level_interactions: Later REACH and first CLOSE_BEYOND events use the same close and reach rules as a horizontal line. They do not delete the level.
range: UNCERTAIN. R.40 requires two reactions on each side and no prior close outside, but it does not say which support pairs with which resistance. No range object is emitted.
prefix_cut_role: Causality check only. It is not a market threshold.
